caption:
The annual money checklist 🌿 — monthly, quarterly, yearly.

Money admin isn't a daily job. It runs on a calendar — and once it's written down, nothing ambushes you.

🗓️ Every month (10 mins): fill your planner on payday, tick bills as they leave, do one mid-month check-in, end with a 5-minute reflection.
🔁 Every 3 months: scan subscriptions, send meter readings, check savings goals, review your sinking funds.
📆 Once a year: compare car & home insurance before they auto-renew, check broadband & mobile at contract end, diary MOT & car tax, check your tax code, review your council tax payment plan and what your savings actually pay.

Then give the dates a home: the planner's end-of-month page has a Notes & Reminders box — next month's bills and renewals, written down before they surprise you.
